dropConnection.description: drop the connection with a clean close; ignored when resetConnection or streamError is set

resetConnection.description: reset the connection with a TCP RST (SO_LINGER 0) instead of returning a response, so the client sees connection reset by peer; over HTTP/2 the whole connection is reset, over HTTP/3 the QUIC connection is closed with H3_INTERNAL_ERROR; takes precedence over streamError and dropConnection

streamError.description: reset the matched request stream with this error code (HTTP/2 RST_STREAM / HTTP/3 RESET_STREAM) instead of returning a response; HTTP/1.1 has no stream concept so this falls back to dropping the connection
